phases.title: The Contracts section and the Contract page
phases.goal: Contracts leaves Master data for its own section of the Admin app, and every Contract gets a page of its own (D92). Routes: an /admin/contracts route block with the index list, /admin/contracts/:contractId (keyed by the Contract id, never the AA code, because the AA code is editable) and /admin/contracts/new, which still opens the old ContractEditSheet in create mode until 46. A Contracts side-nav entry goes between Ledger and Master data (SideNav.tsx, AdminApp sectionForPath). /admin/masters?view=contracts, with &contract=<id> or &holder=<PartyId>, redirects to the new routes (D93), so the capture recipes, the demo guide and Playwright keep loading until the owner's sweep; in-app links go to the routes directly. The list moves to apps/admin/screens/contracts on AdminPage fit with a LineTabs strip. Contracts is live there; Parties and Funding tags link to their Master data views until 48. The list keeps today's holder headings, search and status filter until 47 groups it. The Contract page sits on ProfilePage fluid with the 412px rail. Its header shows name, AA code and status, with Disable or Make active. Its tabs are Overview, Bookings, Event fees and History. The Overview cards are each edited and saved on their own through a new shared Card editing/footer variant, as one editContract patch and one audited change (US-04.1.3, per card), refused on the card with the rule's reason. The cards are: price (the price ranges table, or the rate or discount); where it is offered; who it bills, with the holder Party's billing name and delivery read-only and a link to change them on the Party; names and codes; and what was fixed at creation (holder, pricing kind, prepaid), read-only. The price ranges become a table (US-04.2.15), newest first, with From, To worked out, Price, Change on the range before, and Procedures priced from a new pure, tested proceduresPerRange. The current and future ranges always show; ended ranges fold after three behind 'Show earlier'; a range is added or corrected as a row. The rail, 'On this Contract', lists the upcoming not-yet-billed Procedures and the authorised ones at their locked price. Disable asks first (DM-04, US-04.1.2 Disable confirmed): a ConfirmSheet danger variant lists stillOnContract from today, and nothing moves; Make active undoes it. System Contracts (No contract · RVG and the backstops) have the same page, with only name, AA code and invoice description editable and no Disable. The side panel's edit path and its after-the-disable listing are retired; create keeps the panel until 46. Layout: docs/explorations/contracts-section.html #map, #catalogue (the list frame), #record and #updating.
phases.delivers: A Contracts entry in the Admin side nav between Ledger and Master data, with the Contract list moved there and the old Master data links redirected. A page per Contract at its id: cards edited and saved one at a time, each one audited change, refused in place; the holder Party's billing details read-only; the price ranges as a newest-first table with To, Change and Procedures priced, ended ranges folded after three; the Procedures on it, its event fees and its history; Disable confirmed, listing the Procedures from today; system Contracts limited. The edit side panel is retired, though create keeps it until 46

Its routes and `when` move from Master data (adminMasters.view === 'contracts', adminContracts.openContractId) to /admin/contracts and the Face lift's /admin/contracts/:contractId. phases.title: Replace a Contract from a date
phases.goal:
Replace a Contract from a date, in one action (US-04.1.8, DM-01, DM-02, DM-03). This also builds US-04.1.3's replacement audit, finishing that story (D96). 'Replace from a date' in the Contract page header (45) opens a SidePanel record sheet with:
- the change date
- the new Contract, copied from the old one with any setting changed, the settings fixed at creation included (46's rule-order sections), and a new AA code
- the Procedures dated on or after the date still on the old Contract (proceduresStillOnContract; authorised Lists left out), each ticked or not, with a per-row outcome where a move is refused
- leave the old one Active, with a to-do on the date, or disable it now
A store action, replaceContract, applies it in one change set: the create, then the ticked moves (one audited Procedure change each), then the disable where chosen, audited as US-04.1.3 says. DM-01: the link and the date ride the new Contract's contract.create audit entry (replaces {contractId, fromISO}), read back both ways (D94). DM-03: a warning rule, a To-do and never a blocker: 'a replaced Contract is still active on or after its replacement's date'. It shows in the Day view To-do, opening the old Contract's page, and on that page, and goes once the old Contract is disabled. The late disable: disabling a replaced Contract after its change date lists the Procedures from that date (45's dialog, given the date from DM-01). A replacement not priced as a fixed price says it is offered from today, not from the date; both are offered until the old one is disabled (OQ-144, D90). A fixed price changing from a date points to adding a price range, and a system Contract offers no Replace. The list header's 'any other dated change is a new Contract' copy names Replace. BACKLOG's 'Build what S5 promises' loses its Contract half. Layout: docs/explorations/contracts-section.html #updating and #record (the header).
phases.delivers: Replace from a date as one action: a copy with any setting changed and a new AA code; the Procedures from the date listed, locked ones left out and only the ticked ones moved; the old Contract left active with a to-do on the date, or disabled now. Every step is audited in one change set. A late disable lists the Procedures from the change date. A 'Demo: reach the change date' button
demo_triggers: Admin · Contracts list and a replaced Contract's page: 'Demo: reach the change date' (new, harness bar only), shown while a replacement's change date is still ahead. It moves the demo clock to that date with the existing advanceClockToDate action (shared/demoClockShortcuts.ts, as the prepayment trigger does). The 'Disable <old Contract>' to-do then appears in the Day view To-do and on the old Contract's page while it is still offered. The button is disabled once the date is reached, and the Control Panel's reset puts the clock back
Product, no trigger: Replace from a date on a rate Contract (copy at the new rate, tick Procedures, leave active or disable now); a late disable listing from the change date
PWA: none (Admin only)
phases.risks: The only new domain action; the delta sizes DM-02 at L, so one session, two at most. setProcedureContract (store/contractSelectionActions.ts) has no planner and has side effects: it clears the typed price and rail answers, can re-open a completed Booking, and can settle a prepayment after its commit. Either refactor it into a planner so replaceContract commits once, or sequence per-Procedure commits after the create. Either way, move first, then disable. Each move passes contractPickRefusal: the copy may change holder, links or specialties, and proceduresStillOnContract does not leave out removed Draft Lists, so show a per-row outcome. DM-01's home follows D94 (the audit entry). A stored field would mean a PERSIST_VERSION bump and a date on the Contract, against 'No dates'. Record the choice. Event fees are separate records (masters.contractEventFees) that planContractCreate does not copy. Default: the copy carries them ('every other setting'), on the owner's review list. The warning rule's subject is a Contract, but WarningFacts is one Booking. Either extend the rule mechanism for a Contract subject, or derive the To-do row from a pure rule in domain/warnings/rules (the noContract row's pattern); it is never a blocker. WarningsToDo's ordering needs a rule for a row with no session, and RailWorkCard needs a way to open a Contract. A re-enabled old Contract brings the to-do back (it is derived). System Contracts are guarded as systemNeverDisabled guards them. BACKLOG's 'Build what S5 promises' names two things: delete its Contract half and keep the missing-NHI list as its own line, since nothing here builds it. By default nothing is seeded (the presenter replaces live). 'Reach the change date' moves the global demo clock.
